products.name: macOS App Deployment & Apple VPP with Microsoft Intune (App Store + Enterprise Apps) — Commercial
products.short_description: Deploy and license Mac apps via Intune + Apple VPP — App Store and enterprise apps, token/license sync, updates — without touching the device, deployed pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Deliver and license Mac apps without touching the device

Getting the right apps — App Store and enterprise — onto managed Macs, licensed and updated, is a persistent gap. This solution stands up macOS app deployment through Microsoft Intune with Apple's Volume Purchase Program (VPP): connect the ABM/VPP token, sync licenses, deploy store and line-of-business apps, and keep them updated — deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the macOS app-delivery model in Intune (VPP location tokens, device- vs user-licensing, store apps, LOB .pkg/.dmg, unmanaged PKG) and the deployment model.
  • Requirements Guide — prerequisites (ABM + VPP location + token, Intune app connector, Entra groups, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to connect the VPP token, sync licenses, add and assign store + enterprise apps to the named pilot group, validate install/licensing, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — app/VPP-token discovery, per-device app + license validation, an app/VPP-license coverage report, safe remediation of failed installs/licenses, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (app installed, licensed, updated) plus Best Practices for token renewal and licensing model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The right apps on every Mac — store and enterprise, licensed via VPP and kept current — delivered from Intune and proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MACVPP-Discovery.ps1 — tenant readiness check for macOS app deployment via Apple VPP
    • MACVPP-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation helpers for macOS app deployment via Apple VPP
    • MACVPP-Report.ps1 — tenant-wide report of macOS app deployment and VPP license consumption
    • MACVPP-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build the target Entra group and retarget macOS app assignments
    • MACVPP-Validation.ps1 — validate one Mac against the solution's app + licensing acceptance gate

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
